build_mask2former_decoder: build a MultiScaleMaskedTransformerDecoder for mask classification with configurable queries, heads, and decoder layers
create_self_attention_layer: create a SelfAttentionLayer with multihead attention, layer norm, dropout, and optional pre-normalization
create_cross_attention_layer: create a CrossAttentionLayer that attends between target queries and memory features with positional embeddings
create_ffn_layer: create a FFNLayer with two linear layers, dropout, layer norm, and configurable activation function
create_conv2d_wrapper: create a Conv2d wrapper that supports optional normalization and activation layers after convolution
